description: Record what a memory's source says when your work ALREADY took you there — never go verifying memories as a task. A conflicting one: propose the correction with arroway_remember. On a FINDING, source_gone archives it and a conflict is corrected in place.

memory.description: The #handle from the read, or the full id.

note.description: Required for conflicts (what the source says) and source_gone (what proves removal).

outcome.description: source_gone = PROVEN removed, never a timeout or login wall. conflicts = the source says something different.

name: arroway_verify
title: Record what the source says
